Synopsis:
    Uganda has officially named its crude oil grade "Pearl Sweet" ahead of planned commercial oil production start by end of 2025. The grade is a low-sulphur, waxy blend comparable to Chad's Doba and South Sudan's Nile/Dar crudes. Export will flow via the $5B East African Crude Oil Pipeline to Tanzania's Tanga port. TotalEnergies (56.67%) and CNOOC (28.33%) are the key private stakeholders. Peak production is expected at 230,000 bpd from estimated 6.65 billion barrels recoverable reserves. Commercial outreach and refinery negotiations are now commencing.
